articles.title: Ontario's police watchdog to investigate fatal officer-involved shooting in Mississauga
articles.summary: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating an officer-involved shooting that took place in Mississauga early Thursday morning.

articles.title: Tow truck torched in Brampton driveway overnight as Peel police investigate

articles.title: Toronto police to update most recent U.S. Consulate shooting investigation
articles.summary: The 11 a.m. briefing follows the incident from July 27, when Toronto police responded to reports of shots fired outside the U.S. Consulate on University Avenue.

articles.title: 1 male dead, 3 arrested after overnight police shooting in Mississauga

articles.title: Vigil held for Calgary boy, 11, found dead in pipe system after disappearance
articles.summary: CALGARY — A vigil was held outside Calgary's city hall on Wednesday evening for an 11-year-old boy with autism who was found dead inside a labyrinth of water pipes a week earlier.

articles.summary: The federal government will be joining the Ontario government and City of Toronto in helping to fund the return of Taste of the Danforth, the Greektown on the Danforth Business Improvement Area announced Wednesday. articles.title: Mississauga man charged following sudden death of Cambridge man after taking part 'healing experience'
articles.summary: Police in Waterloo region have arrested and charged a Mississauga man in the death of a Cambridge man last month. Police say the Cambridge man took part in a private ibogaine healing experience. Ibogaine is a psychoactive alkaloid that is not authorized for use in Canada.

articles.title: Ford calls byelections in 3 Ontario ridings
articles.summary: A writ was issued Wednesday for byelections in Scarborough Southwest, York–Simcoe and Hamilton East–Stoney Creek. In a news release, the province said that voting day will be on Sept. 3.
